AddAxnTrackNo.description_en: Adds a tracking number for a private number in the AXN binding

AddSecretBlacklist.description_zh: 向号码池添加黑名单。仅AXN隐私号、AXN分机号、95AXN隐私号类型的号码池支持设置黑名单

BindAXBCall.description_en: Requests the work number platform to create a call binding relationship (B, X, A) for employee B's work number X, allowing employee B to call customer A through work number X
BindAXBCall.description_zh: 接入方调用本接口向工作号平台请求为员工B的工作号X建立呼叫绑定关系（B，X，A），允许员工B通过工作号X呼叫客户A

BindAxb.description_zh: AXB中间号，是将拨打关系限定在一对一关系中，用户A可以通过中间号码X联系到用户B，用户B也可以通过中间号码X联系到用户A

BindAxb700.description_en: Binds phone numbers for a 700AXB private number. A 700AXB private number restricts the calling relationship to a one-to-one relationship. User A can contact User B through the intermediate number X that starts with 700, and User B can also contact User A through the same intermediate number X
BindAxb700.description_zh: 700AXB中间号，是将拨打关系限定在一对一关系中，用户A可以通过700开头的中间号码X联系到用户B，用户B也可以通过700开头的中间号码X联系到用户A

BindAxbFixedLine.description_en: The fixed-line AXB privacy number binding restricts the calling relationship to a one-to-one relationship. User A can contact User B through the fixed-line intermediate number X, and User B can also contact User A through the intermediate number X. The fixed-line privacy number service is currently available by invitation only. Please contact your technical support to activate the service and obtain integration support
BindAxbFixedLine.description_zh: 固话绑定AXB隐私号，是将拨打关系限定在一对一关系中，用户A可以通过固话中间号码X联系到用户B，用户B也可以通过中间号码X联系到用户A。固话隐私号目前为邀约制，请联系您的技术支持进行服务开通，并提供对接支持

BindAxg.description_zh: 添加AXG号码的绑定关系。AXG产品是针对有用户分级需求、限制呼叫范围、限制抢单等场景的客户需求提供的号码隐私保护解决方案，其中G代表一个号码组，可以根据需要添加号码

BindAxn.description_en: Creates a binding for an AXN Privacy Number. This process assigns a dedicated Privacy Number (the X Number) to User A, allowing any caller to connect to User A by dialing the X Number
BindAxn.description_zh: 添加AXN隐私号的绑定关系。AXN隐私号是为A用户分配一个专属的隐私号，任何号码N通过拨打X号码都可以转接到A

BindAxnExtension.description_en: AXN with extension creates a binding. This feature is similar to AXN for privacy protection but introduces an extension to reduce the usage of X numbers. To place a call, a caller dials the X number, hears a prompt, and then enters the corresponding extension to transfer the call to Party A
BindAxnExtension.description_zh: 添加AXN分机号的绑定关系。AXN分机号与AXN隐私号功能类似，AXN分机号在AXN基础上引入了分机号，从而降低X号码的使用量，在呼叫时候首先拨打X号码，听到提示音后输入对应分机号转接到A

BindAxnExtensionFixedLine.description_en: The fixed-line AXN extension number introduces extension numbers on top of the fixed-line AXN privacy number, thereby reducing the usage of X numbers. When making a call, first dial the X number, and then enter the corresponding extension number after hearing the prompt tone to be connected to A. The fixed-line AXN extension number service is currently invitation-only. Contact your technical support to activate the service and obtain integration support
BindAxnExtensionFixedLine.description_zh: 固话AXN分机号在固话AXN隐私号基础上引入了分机号，从而降低X号码的使用量，在呼叫时候首先拨打X号码，听到提示音后输入对应分机号转接到A。固话AXN分机号目前为邀约制，请联系您的技术支持进行服务开通，并提供对接支持

BindAxnFixedLine.description_en: Binds a number to a fixed-line AXN private number. User A is assigned a dedicated private number X, and any number N can be forwarded to A by calling X. The fixed-line private number feature is currently available by invitation only. Contact your technical support to activate the service and obtain integration support
BindAxnFixedLine.description_zh: 固话绑定AXN隐私号，是将A用户分配到一个专属的隐私号，任何号码N通过拨打X号码都可以转接到A。固话隐私号目前为邀约制，请联系您的技术支持进行服务开通，并提供对接支持

BindBatchAxg.description_en: Adds AXG bindings in batches. The AXG model is a Phone Number Protection Solution for scenarios requiring User Tiering, Call Scope Restriction, or Order Grabbing Restriction. In this model, G represents a Number Group, to which you can add phone numbers
BindBatchAxg.description_zh: 批量添加AXG号码的绑定关系。AXG产品是针对有用户分级需求、限制呼叫范围、限制抢单等场景的客户需求提供的号码隐私保护解决方案，其中G代表一个号码组，可以根据需要添加号码

BindGxb700.description_en: Adds a binding relationship for a 700GXB private number. The 700GXB product is a privacy protection solutions designed for scenarios that require user-level classification, call scope restrictions, and order-grabbing restrictions. In this product, G represents a number group, and you can add numbers to the group as needed
BindGxb700.description_zh: 添加700GXB号码的绑定关系。700GXB产品是针对有用户分级需求、限制呼叫范围、限制抢单等场景的客户需求提供的号码隐私保护解决方案，其中G代表一个号码组，可以根据需要添加号码

BindXB.description_en: Requests the work number platform to create an association (B, X) between a specified work number X and an employee number B. The binding takes effect only after the employee (number B) completes real-name verification for work number X. After the binding succeeds, all calls to work number X are forwarded to employee number B. The work number platform pushes the binding result to the caller through the asynchronous notification API
BindXB.description_zh: 接入方调用本接口请求工作号平台为指定工作号X和员工号码B建立关联（B，X）。仅当员工（号码B）完成工作号X的实名认证之后，关系绑定才会生效。关系绑定成功后，所有对工作号X的呼叫都会转接到员工号码B。工作号平台通过“异步通知接口”，把关系绑定的结果推送到接入方

ConfigX.description_en: Configures an X number to individually set up communication features such as voice calls and enterprise name cards for the work number
ConfigX.description_zh: 配置X号码，单独对工作号的话音呼叫、企业名片等通信功能进行配置操作

CreateAxgGroup.description_zh: 创建G号码组。仅AXG隐私号类型的号码池支持设置G号码组

CreateFixedNoAReport.description_en: Submit Individual Information of a landline number A through an API
CreateFixedNoAReport.description_zh: 通过API提交A号码固话个人信息报备

CreatePhoneNoAReport.description_en: Submit Individual Information of an A-number mobile phone number through an API
CreatePhoneNoAReport.description_zh: 通过API提交A号码手机号个人信息报备

CreateSmsSign.description_en: In the scenario where Employee B sends an SMS to Customer A through work number X, Employee B uses the client to send an SMS to Customer A. The client must call this API to obtain an "SMS sending tag" and append the "tag" to the end of the SMS content. The work number platform parses the real called number A through the "tag" and sends the SMS to number A
CreateSmsSign.description_zh: 员工B通过工作号X向客户A下发短信场景中，员工B使用客户端向客户A 发送短信，客户端须通过本接口获取“短信下发标签”，并在短信内容尾部中添加该“标签”。工作号平台通过“标签”解析出真实被叫A号码，下发短信到A号码

DeleteAxbBindFixedLine.description_en: Unbind a fixed-line AXB privacy number
DeleteAxbBindFixedLine.description_zh: 解除固话AXB隐私号绑定关系

DeleteAxgGroup.description_en: Deletes a G group. G groups are supported only in Number Pools designated for the AXG privacy number type
DeleteAxgGroup.description_zh: 删除G号码组。仅AXG隐私号类型的号码池支持设置G号码组

DeleteAxnBindFixedLine.description_en: Unbinds a fixed-line AXN private number binding relationship
DeleteAxnBindFixedLine.description_zh: 解除固话AXN隐私号码绑定关系

DeleteAxnExtensionBindFixedLine.description_en: Unbind a fixed-line AXN extension number binding
DeleteAxnExtensionBindFixedLine.description_zh: 解除固话AXN分机号绑定关系

DeleteSecretBlacklist.description_zh: 删除号码池的黑名单。仅AXN隐私号、AXN分机号、95AXN隐私号类型的号码池支持设置黑名单

GetDyplsOSSInfoForUploadFile.description_en: Obtain OSS resource configuration information. This configuration information will be used for subsequent OSS image upload operations.
GetDyplsOSSInfoForUploadFile.description_zh: 获取OSS资源配置信息，此配置信息将用于后续OSS图片上传操作

GetSecretAsrDetail.description_en: Obtains the details of the automatic speech recognition (ASR) result

GetTotalPublicUrl.description_en: Obtains the download URL of a recorded ringing tone
GetTotalPublicUrl.description_zh: 获取响铃放音的录音下载链接

GetXConfig.description_en: Retrieves the configuration information of an X number

GetXDefaultConfig.description_en: Retrieves the default configurations of an X number
GetXDefaultConfig.description_zh: 获取X号码默认配置信息

ListXTelephones.description_en: Queries the list of X numbers under a customer
ListXTelephones.description_zh: 查询客户名下X号码列表

LockSecretNo.description_zh: 锁定号码。适用于需要临时屏蔽异常号码的场景

OperateAxgGroup.description_zh: 修改G号码组中的号码，可以对号码进行添加、删除、全量替换操作

OperateBlackNo.description_en: Adds a phone number to a blacklist or deletes a phone number from a blacklist
OperateBlackNo.description_zh: 新增或删除号池黑名单。仅AXN隐私号、AXN分机号、95AXN隐私号类型的号码池支持设置黑名单

QueryAxbBindFixedLine.description_en: Queries the binding information of an AXB landline privacy number
QueryAxbBindFixedLine.description_zh: 查询已绑定固话AXB隐私号信息

QueryAxnBindFixedLine.description_en: Queries the binding information of an AXN landline privacy number
QueryAxnBindFixedLine.description_zh: 查询已绑定固话AXN隐私号码信息

QueryAxnExtensionBindFixedLine.description_en: Queries the binding information of a landline AXN extension number
QueryAxnExtensionBindFixedLine.description_zh: 查询已绑定固话AXN分机号信息

QueryPhoneNoAByTrackNo.description_en: Queries the details about a tracking number

QueryRecordFileDownloadUrl.description_en: Obtains the download URL of a recording file
QueryRecordFileDownloadUrl.description_zh: 根据号码池Key、呼叫记录ID、呼叫发起时间等获取录音文件的下载链接

QuerySecretAPhoneNoToCust.description_en: Query the reporting status of an A number

QuerySecretNoDetail.description_en: Queries the attributes of a private number
QuerySecretNoDetail.description_zh: 查询隐私号码的属性信息

QuerySecretNoRemain.description_en: Queries the quantity of remaining phone numbers available for online purchase
QuerySecretNoRemain.description_zh: 查询线上可购号码余量

QuerySoundRecord.description_en: Query the downloadable call recording URL by call ID on the enterprise side
QuerySoundRecord.description_zh: 企业侧通过callId查询可下载的通话录音地址

QuerySubsId.description_zh: 查询绑定关系的唯一标识SubsId

QuerySubscriptionDetail.description_en: Queries the details about a phone number binding
QuerySubscriptionDetail.description_zh: 查询号码的绑定详情。获取号码绑定关系状态、分机号码、是否录音、ASR状态等信息

ReleaseSecretNo.description_zh: 释放号码。释放后所选号码将不可继续使用

UnBindAXB.description_en: Unbinds a specified AXB call binding relationship (A, X, B). After the call binding relationship is unbound, employee B cannot call customer A through work number X
UnBindAXB.description_zh: 接入方调用本接口解除指定的呼叫绑定关系（A，X，B），解除呼叫绑定关系后，员工B不能通过工作号X呼叫到客户A

UnBindXB.description_en: Cancels the binding between work number X and employee number B. After the binding is canceled, calls to number X will not be forwarded to number B
UnBindXB.description_zh: 调用本接口可取消工作号X与员工号码B的绑定。绑定解除后，对X的呼叫都不会转接给B

UnbindSubs700.description_en: Unbinds a 700 number from its binding relationship

UnlockSecretNo.description_zh: 解锁号码。解除号码的临时屏蔽

UpdateAxbBindFixedLine.description_en: Modifies the binding information of a landline AXB privacy number
UpdateAxbBindFixedLine.description_zh: 修改固话AXB隐私号绑定信息

UpdateAxnBindFixedLine.description_en: Modifies the binding information of a landline AXN private number
UpdateAxnBindFixedLine.description_zh: 修改固话AXN隐私号码绑定信息

UpdateAxnExtensionBindFixedLine.description_en: Modifies the binding relationship of a landline AXN extension number
UpdateAxnExtensionBindFixedLine.description_zh: 修改固话AXN分机号码绑定关系

UpdateSubs700.description_en: Modifies the binding relationship of a 700 number
